production_scope: Ten native landscape candidates only; portraits paused. All supplied references retained and mapped.

continuity.narrative_arc: A tied toddler sees the twin trees; Kubera’s sons encounter Narada, become the paired Arjuna trees, are released by Krishna and receive devotion; Nanda frees Krishna and the village carries him home unharmed.
continuity.krishna_form_contract: All D048 scenes depict one age-grounded toddler Krishna in ordinary two-arm/two-leg human child form. The stanzas do not call for a four-armed revelation. Keep one identity and child proportions throughout.
continuity.shared_identity: Nalakuvara and Manigriva remain the same two named brothers through the human, paired-tree, and Yaksha scenes. The canonical source does not specify their distinct facial, hair, complexion, or body markers. The S002 candidate and mapped illustrations provide provisional scene cues only, not canonical character masters. Preserve exactly two separate figures and use the stanza plan for each actual form.
continuity.supporting_character_status: Yashoda, Nandagopan, gopas and Narada follow existing character bibles. The named brothers use one source-grounded paired depiction contract; it is not an approved character master. River women remain scene-specific supporting cast, with clothing and count controlled by the mapped source and plan.

continuity.palette_arc: Warm Gokula cream and ochre opens into river blues and grove greens, then resolves into soft ochre light and a calm homeward return; preserve the matte D001 mineral mural surface.
continuity.notes: All ten numbered scene references were mapped and opened at full frame. References are not copied literally. Stanzas 3–4 depict adult bathing participants modestly clothed. Stanzas 9–10 bind Nandagopan, Yashoda and gopas. The S010 illustration follows the mapped safe-return scene; closing prayer remains in text and no separate Bhattathiri tableau is added.
